articles.title: Russia’s parliament passes crypto market law with $3,800 annual cap for retail investors
articles.snippet: While citizens still cannot use Bitcoin to buy groceries, the Kremlin is officially letting companies use digital tokens to bypass sanctions and other global trade hurdles.

articles.title: US officials barred until 2029 from issuing or sponsoring tokens under CLARITY’s proposed ethics rules
articles.snippet: According to Senator Cynthia Lummis, one of the bill’s advocates, the ethics language would apply to US presidents’ crypto ventures, including Donald Trump’s.

articles.title: The digital euro: Surveillance money, or a better alternative to cash?
articles.snippet: Proponents of the digital euro say its a better alternative to cash that’s fully backed by the ECB. But critics argue it could provide the EU with too much power over its citizens.

articles.title: Balaji’s Network School turns to Kazakhstan amid Malaysia setback
articles.snippet: The agreement gives Balaji Srinivasan’s tech community a potential new base as Malaysian authorities clamp down on the Network School over alleged licensing breaches.

articles.title: Movement Labs files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy after months of MOVE token turmoil
articles.snippet: The blockchain developer will continue operating under court supervision as it restructures following a market-making scandal, a co-founder’s suspension and exchange delistings that rocked the project.
